title: VPG Engine — Rings
description: The rings an arena can use. An arena names a ring by its GLB path; one that names none gets the first ring listed here.

schema_version.description: Optional rings schema version. Current version is 1.

glb.description: Project-relative path to the ring GLB. Gameplay finds the mat and ropes by mesh name, so it needs a mesh containing `canvas` and meshes starting with `rope`.

defaultTextures.description: Renderer-owned art for materials the GLB ships without, keyed by material name. Applied before the arena's own ringTextures, so an arena still wins. Leave it out for a ring whose GLB embeds every texture it needs: its parts then keep their baked textures unless the arena names one.

steps.description: Where the two sets of ring steps sit, measured from this ring's corners. Positions and [x, y, z, w] quaternions are in the steps GLB's own (glTF) frame.
